subject: STraTA status: repro strong, self-training stability caveat
body:
Hi Alina, Anders,

Repro landed March 5. On our three few-shot benchmarks (64 labels each) STraTA gives +9 to +14 accuracy points over few-shot fine-tuning alone, and as the repo promises, our numbers modestly beat the paper's. Task augmentation is doing the heavy lifting: synthetic NLI data alone accounts for roughly two thirds of the gain, with the self-training rounds adding the rest.

The caveat for the recipe doc: self-training is sensitive to the pseudo-label confidence threshold in low-resource regimes. With a sloppy threshold, round 3+ can drift - we saw one benchmark lose 4 points between rounds when we deliberately misconfigured it. The practical recommendation is the paper's: strict thresholding plus early stopping on a small dev set, and the recipe will make the dev-set requirement explicit rather than optional.

Rosa's distributed configs are done; Nikhil's distillation work is on track, first regression-tested config set due April 8.

Umar
